args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP, so half-cent values
always rounded up (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.67). The tests and FIN-212 require
banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), where ties round to the nearest
even cent (2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py`'s `round_money` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing half-cent ties to always round up (e.g. `2.665` → `2.67`).
- Changed to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (banker's rounding), per FIN-212 and the expectations in `tests/test_money.py` (`2.665` → `2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed (tests/test_money.py included).
- Merging requires approval from a code owner per org policy.

Fixes nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
